question: Arjun Singh Dhurve was conferred the Padma Shri in 2022 for his contribution to the Baiga dance form of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjun Singh Dhurve** was conferred the **Padma Shri in 2022** for his contribution to the **Baiga dance form **of **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• Baiga dance form is a** traditional dance form **of the Baiga tribe, which is an **indigenous community **residing in the **central **Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The dance form is characterized by its **unique costumes, music, and movements**, which depict the** daily life and culture** of the Baiga tribe.
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurve is a renowned **Baiga dancer** and has been actively** promoting and preserving the Baiga dance** form for over two decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the famous dance forms of **Odissa** includes** Odissi dance, Chhau dance, Gotipua Dance and Ghumura Dance.**
 
• Some of the famous dance forms of **Rajasthan** includes **Ghoomar, Kalbeliya, Bhavai, Kacchi Ghodi and Gair.**
 
• Some of the famous dance forms of **West Bengal** includes **Baul**** dance, Santhal dance, Fakir, Bitra, Lathi, Gajan, Ranpa, Chhau, etc**
